pages.text:
Meters sit in a line and measure what flows through them: in on the left side (as you face the screen), out on the right.
- Energy Meter: FE, up to 65,536 FE/t.
- Heat Meter: heat, up to 3,200 HU/t.
- Fluid Meter: liquids only, up to 12,800 mB/t.
- Gas Meter: gases only, through Pressurized Conduits, up to 25,600 mB/t.
The front screen shows the live rate.
# Redstone
In the GUI, set a threshold and a mode:
- Above: signal while the rate is above the threshold.
- Below: signal while the rate is below it.
The meter outputs a signal of 15 on every side while the condition holds, and its LED lights. A comparator reads the rate on its own: 0 when idle, 15 at the meter's maximum.
